items.summary: SolarWinds patched a critical command injection flaw in Dameware, rated CVSS 9.9 and disclosed on November 3. No exploitation had been confirmed at disclosure; apply the fixed Dameware release promptly.

HPE patched 46 flaws in Fabric Composer, worst CVE-2026-95731 (CVSS 9.8), an unauthenticated hardcoded-password flaw letting an attacker log in and gain administrative access. It affects Fabric Composer 7.4.0 and below and 7.3.4 and below; upgrade to 7.4.1 or 7.3.5.

A use-after-free flaw in the Linux kernel's IPv4 TCP handling, rated CVSS 9.8, can allow remote unauthenticated code execution via a race during TCP connection setup. Red Hat shipped fixed kernels for RHEL 8, 9 and 10; Ubuntu fixes for older LTS releases were still in testing as of November 3.

A report-deserialization remote code execution flaw in Puppet Server, rated CVSS 9.4 and disclosed November 3, now has a public proof of concept that runs a shell command on the server. Update OpenVox or Puppet Enterprise to 2023.8.13, 2025.12.1 or 2026.0.1; no exploitation had been confirmed at disclosure.

In node-opcua before 2.180.0, namespace-level access control set via setDefaultRolePermissions is not honoured for nodes without explicit per-node RolePermissions, a critical flaw rated CVSS 9.1 disclosed November 3. Upgrade to version 2.180.0, which fixes the issue.
